backup.title: Data & Backup
backup.hint: Keep copies of your local database. A safety backup is always created before restoring.

error.backup_unavailable: Backup requires a file-based SQLite database.

about.title: About
about.description: Personal finance tracker: income, spending, budgets and goals.
privacy.local: Your financial data is stored locally on this device.
privacy.offline: The app does not send your records to external services. No telemetry or online account is used.
